mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates economic weakness, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in retail sales by more than 1% month-over-month signals a decline in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS decreased by more than 1% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% month-over-month signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable economic environment conducive to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods where CPIAUCSL was below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and retail sales by more than 1% month-over-month signals a broad-based increase in demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increased by more than 1% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by an increase in unemployment rate.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decrease > 1% quarter-over-quarter and UNRATE increase
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 decreased by more than 1% and UNRATE increased in the previous quarter.
